SourceStore (deprecated compatibility ledger)

Source: R/models.R
SourceStore.Rd

SourceStore was renamed in Tempest 0.2.0. Use tempest_research_workspace() for new code. This subclass temporarily retains the legacy arbitrary artifact surface while product callers move to explicit STORM and Co-STORM state.

SourceStore$new()

Create a deprecated SourceStore compatibility object.

Usage

SourceStore$new(
  max_sources = Inf,
  base_snapshot_id = NULL,
  accepted_graft_references = list()
)

Arguments

max_sources

Maximum number of unique resources admitted.

base_snapshot_id

Optional opaque identifier for the pinned accepted-knowledge snapshot.

accepted_graft_references

Unnamed list of canonical JSON-compatible references to accepted graft records.
